data.body: **[P2] Do not treat `isReplay` as proof that this completion was already exported.** An invocation may receive update IDs for several concurrent operations, observe one, then suspend before awaiting another. When the latter operation is first visited in a subsequent invocation, its ID is no longer in that invocation's `UpdatedOperationIds`, so it is marked replay and this branch permanently drops its span and error. Export `InvocationInfo.updatedOperations` independently of workflow traversal, or persist acknowledgement until each completion reaches `onOperationEnd`; add an integration test with an intervening suspension before the completed callback/invoke is awaited.
